overview.title: Quiet Bay, Historic Horizon
overview.p1: Bades Bay is one of the most photogenic stops on the Al Hoceima coast: calm sand looking toward the historic rock of Bades.
overview.p2: Rewards a slower visit — swimming when the sea allows, walking the shore, and taking in the cliffs.
overview.p3: Works well with Torres de Alcalá or Cala Iris if you have a driver for the park coast.

q1.question: Is Bades good for swimming?
q1.answer: Often yes in calm conditions; check the day’s sea state.

q2.question: Is it crowded?
q2.answer: Usually quieter than Quemado, especially outside peak weekends.

q3.question: How to get there?
q3.answer: By road along the park coast; a local driver is recommended.

q4.question: Facilities?
q4.answer: Limited; bring water, shade and supplies for a few hours.

q5.question: Combine with Torres?
q5.answer: Yes — a natural pairing on a park-coast day.
